games.name: Superforest [🍉]
games.desc:
🌱💚✨ Play. Grow. Reforest the World! ✨💚🌳

Welcome to Superforest!  Build the forest of your dreams with friends! A magical forest-building adventure awaits.

What you do:

🧱 Build your forest. Buy and place soil tiles, create your perfect forest layout.
🌱 Plant magical trees. Plant seeds, grow trees over time, and unlock rarer species as your forest expands.
🍒 Harvest and earn. Collect orbs, harvest fruits, sell at the market, and reinvest to grow faster, bigger, and rarer.
🧬 Find mutations. Harvests mutate during weather changes & magical events
🐾 Collect pets. Unlock powerful companions to help your forest grow.

Work together and boost growth and harvest for everyone:
✨ Contribute potions into the Spirit Well to trigger a magical Time Surge! 
🌳 Offer harvest to the Mother Tree shrine to stoke the enchanted fire!
🧙 Witching hour happens every night, defend your forest from thieves or share your bounty, the choice is yours!

🔄 Superforest is in beta and active development.
